forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Horizon date Sep 6 passed. No evidence of Iranian official public commitment to talks. Araghchi stated Sep 9 that resuming negotiations is impossible until the US compensates for MOU violations. Active kinetic exchange Sep 1-9 (IRGC BM salvos; CENTCOM tanker strikes) precluded diplomatic space. GlobalSecurity Day 191 (Sep 6) confirms no diplomatic announcement on that date.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Araghchi or SNSC public statement committing to talks
Oman or Qatar mediator readout citing named Iranian acceptance

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (−10pp). Araghchi issued Sep 9 statement explicitly ruling out negotiation resumption until the US compensates for MOU violations — a process precondition, not a negotiating position. Oman channel suspended since Aug 18. Qatar's 'progressive stages' characterization (Aug 4) has not been renewed since the Sep 1-9 kinetic exchanges. IRGC fired 20 ballistic missiles at Al Azraq (Jordan) on Sep 8; CENTCOM destroyed five Iranian tankers the same day. No logistical precondition for a convened session (72h bilateral halt in strikes) has been observed. Residual 5% covers an unannounced Oman technical contact.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Oman/Qatar/Pakistan mediator readout of a convened session
Iran MFA confirms re-engagement or talks readiness
US-Iran bilateral halt in strikes for 72h+ (session precondition)

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (−17pp). CENTCOM destroyed five Iranian tankers on Sep 8 — M/T Kaviz, M/T Charminar, M/T Horizon 1, M/T Riesco (Oman Sea) and M/T Derya (Kharg Island) — the heaviest single-day tanker destruction of the conflict. Commercial transits held at ~6 vessels/day (7-day rolling; Windward/MarineTraffic per Sep 7 data), 93% below pre-war baseline. Iran's Persian Gulf Exclusion Zone (57 blacklisted vessels) remains active and unmodified. Brent crossed $100.29 intraday Sep 9 — markets are not pricing a near-term reopening. With 23 days to horizon and no observable initiation of the causal chain (ceasefire → mine clearance → insurer re-entry → vessel rerouting), the 30-vessel threshold is structurally unreachable. Residual 5% covers abrupt diplomatic agreement.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Windward or MarineTraffic (primary AIS tracker) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03, confirmed by one TIER1 source (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Windward or MarineTraffic as primary AIS tracker showing >=30 commercial transits/day (7-day rolling), plus one TIER1 (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List Intelligence) confirmation.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit. If Windward and MarineTraffic diverge by >20% in their daily count, flag AMBIGUOUS and await reconciliation before resolving. Any IRGC-attributed vessel attack within the resolution window that disrupts AIS tracking extends the AMBIGUOUS flag one additional day.

indicators.name: Windward/MarineTraffic 7-day rolling average reaches >=15 vessels/day (interim threshold)
P&I war-risk cover reinstated by a named insurer for Hormuz passage
CENTCOM or mediator-confirmed Iranian commitment to halt mine/vessel-attack activity

forecasts.question: Will Likud win the most Knesset seats (seat plurality) in the October 27, 2026 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (−2pp). Polling divergence between two reliable pollsters: Jerusalem Post poll (field ~Sep 5-7) shows Likud 24 vs Yashar 23 — Likud leads by one; Kan poll (Sep 6) shows Yashar 23 vs Likud 20 — Yashar leads by three. Judge splits the difference at 0.40, acknowledging genuine uncertainty. Neither Netanyahu's bloc (57-59) nor the opposition bloc (57-59) reaches the 61-seat governing threshold in any survey. Wartime rally effect has not produced a Likud breakthrough. 47 days to election; high polling volatility expected.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Knesset election results published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee show Likud winning more seats than any other single party in the October 27, 2026 election.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official results, carried by Times of Israel/Haaretz/Reuters/AP.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Likud and one other party tie on seats: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (no plurality). Exit polls alone do not resolve; official preliminary results suffice if published before EOD Oct 27.

indicators.name: Polls from ≥2 independent firms showing Likud >=23 seats, ahead of Yashar
indicators.expected_effect: +8pp toward YES (only one of two current polls shows Likud ahead)

indicators.name: Likud bloc forms coalition-eligible alliance pre-election
Eisenkot/Yashar polling surge >=25 seats in >=2 polls

forecasts.question: Will Iran conduct a confirmed ballistic missile or drone strike against a US military asset or GCC partner territory before EOD 2026-09-13?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 72h forecast. IRGC fired 20 ballistic missiles at Al Azraq (Jordan) on Sep 8 in retaliation for CENTCOM's tanker destruction. The tit-for-tat cycle since Sep 1 shows a 2-3 day response cadence from both sides. With CENTCOM destroying five tankers on Sep 8 and Araghchi ruling out diplomatic de-escalation, IRGC's historical pattern under equivalent provocation puts the 72h probability at 0.65. Residual 35% covers IRGC internal debate on escalation ceiling or a tactical pause for repositioning.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM or a GCC partner government confirms an Iranian ballistic missile or UAV strike against a US military facility or GCC partner military territory between 2026-09-10 00:00 UTC and 2026-09-13 23:59 UTC. Houthi attacks do not count unless CENTCOM explicitly attributes direct Iranian command-and-control.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official statement plus at least one TIER1 source (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If attribution is disputed by both Iran and CENTCOM, or if the strike hits only civilian infrastructure without CENTCOM acknowledging the attack: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO pending further confirmation within 24h of the resolution deadline.

indicators.name: IRGC state media threat language elevated ('response imminent' or equivalent)
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES (observed pattern: threat language precedes strikes by 6-24h)

Al Azraq or Ain al-Assad base force protection posture elevated (FPCON change)

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RETIRED-OBE. Knesset completed its full 4-year term and dissolved naturally on 2026-07-17 — the first natural dissolution since 1988. 'Dissolve early' = NO (natural end-of-term, not early). 'Lose majority' = NO (one-seat majority of 61/120 held through dissolution). Both YES resolution paths are now closed. The question is superseded by the scheduled Oct 27 election, which is tracked under F5. Retiring to avoid confusion with the active Likud-plurality forecast.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.name: Degel HaTorah files formal dissolution motion in Knesset
indicators.expected_effect: Knesset dissolved naturally Jul 17; this path is closed

forecasts.question: Will ICE Brent front-month crude settle above $100.00/barrel on three consecutive trading days before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 7-day forecast. Brent settled at $97.89 on Sep 8 and crossed $100.29 intraday on Sep 9 — the first triple-digit intraday print in six weeks. Five Iranian tankers destroyed by CENTCOM on Sep 8; Hormuz transits at ~6/day (7% of pre-war). No IEA emergency release triggered. Three consecutive settlements above $100 requires the kinetic pressure to hold without IEA intervention. 55% reflects high disruption probability but uncertainty about a spontaneous tactical pause or IEA trigger.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if ICE Brent front-month official settlement price exceeds $100.00/barrel on any three trading days (not necessarily consecutive by calendar; any three within the window 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-17) as reported by Bloomberg or Reuters.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: ICE official daily settlement as reported by Bloomberg or Reuters Markets data.
